questions.q: What did Yahweh say to Moses about women who give birth to a male child?
questions.a: Yahweh said to Moses that a woman who gives birth to a male child would be unclean for seven days.

questions.q: What was a woman required to do following her being unclean?
questions.a: She must wait about a month in the impurity of the blood she bled from giving birth. She must not enter the tabernacle or touch anything holy until that time is over.

questions.q: What was a woman required to do differently if she gave birth to a female child?
questions.a: If a woman gives birth to female child, she will be unclean for two weeks. The woman should wait about two months in the impurity of the blood she bled when she gave birth to the baby.

questions.q: What was a woman required to do at the end of her purification?
questions.a: At the end of her purification, a woman should bring a one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a pigeon or dove for a sin offering to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

questions.q: What if the woman who gives birth to a child cannot afford a lamb?
questions.a: If the woman cannot afford a lamb, she must bring two pigeons or two doves for the burnt and sin offerings.

questions.q: What would happen to the woman after she did these things?
questions.a: The woman will be clean after the priest makes atonement for her.

commentary.text: —After the laws concerning clean and unclean food, come the laws concerning clean and unclean persons. Man imparts his depraved nature to his offspring, so that, excepting as the atonement of Christ and the sanctification of the Spirit prevent, the original blessing, “Increase and multiply,” Ge 1:28, is become to the fallen race a direful curse, and communicates sin and misery. Let those women who have received mercy from God in child-bearing, with all thankfulness own God's goodness to them; and this shall please the Lord better than sacrifices.
